text:
Mina Okafor: Hi all  first day! Set up my desk (B2-05) but when I plug into the dock my Mac loses Wi-Fi and the external keyboard stops responding. Laptop works fine on battery and builtin keyboard. Anyone seen this behavior?

Luis Romero: Welcome Mina! That's usually a dock power or firmware issue. Which dock model is on the sticker? Also are you on 'redwood-office' or 'redwood-guest'?

Mina Okafor: Sticker says 'PortBridge 4'. I'm on redwood-office. Ethernet through the dock works, but Wi-Fi drops and keyboard LED blinks then goes idle.

Ava Chen: Quick test: try connecting the keyboard directly to the Mac (not through the dock) and see if it works. Also try using the other USB-C cable from the ops cabinet if available.

Mina Okafor: Keyboard works when plugged directly. I swapped to a spare USB-C cable (from the box) and behavior is the same.

Luis Romero: Thanks. Creating ticket and grabbing a swap. IT-5199 created: "PortBridge 4 - Wi-Fi drop + USB keyboard not enumerating". Assigning to Luis Romero. ETA for drop-off: same day (ops has loaner docks).

it-bot: Ticket IT-5199 created and assigned to Luis Romero on 1777777790.

Luis Romero: I'll bring a loaner PortBridge 2 around 3:15pm. If that fixes it we'll RMA the PortBridge 4.

Mina Okafor: 3:15 works, thanks!

Luis Romero: Swapped dock at 15:18. Loaner PB-2 (asset PB-2001) connected. Wi-Fi stayed connected and keyboard detected immediately. Left a sticky with asset tag.

Mina Okafor: Confirmed  everything stable now. Thanks for the quick help and welcome messages.

Luis Romero: Marking IT-5199 resolved: replaced PortBridge 4 with PB-2001 (RMA logged for original). If anything crops up in the next 48h ping me. :white_check_mark:

it-bot: Ticket IT-5199 status changed to RESOLVED by Luis Romero on 1777777890.
